{{Quote|No one can hide from the Empire.|Unidentified Imperial officer|<ref name="RFH" />}}
An '''Imperial Officer''' was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to take [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from a faction of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] who captured her. The Alderaanian faction brokered a deal with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for a new planet to settle on after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in exchange for the princess. However, the Imperial officer reneged on the deal and had the leaders of the faction killed by his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and took Organa captive.<ref name="RFH" />
